description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks are expected to activate RB Jadarian Price from injured reserve for Monday's game against the Bears.
items.impact: Price will return after a month-long absence. The Seahawks will have a fully healthy backfield for the first time this season between him and Zach Charbonnet.
items.title: Jadarian Price (chest) to be activated from IR Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jevon Holland practiced on Monday.
items.impact: Holland was in concussion protocol heading into the Giants bye week. His presence in practice to begin the week is a good sign for his status heading into Week 9.
items.title: Jevon Holland (concussion) practices Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Greg Newsome II practiced on Monday.
items.impact: Newsome was in concussion protocol heading into the Giants bye week. His presence in practice to begin the week is a good sign for his status heading into Week 9.
items.title: Greg Newsome II (concussion) practices Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Theo Johnson practiced on Monday.
items.impact: Johnson was dealing with a neck injury heading into the Giants bye week. His presence in practice to begin the week is a good sign for his status heading into Week 9.
items.title: Theo Johnson (neck) practices Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Abdul Carter was not seen practicing on Monday.
items.impact: It is unclear what the reason is for Carter's absence. It's the first practice out of the bye week for the Giants.
items.title: Abdul Carter not practicing Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cam Skattebo was practicing on a side field on Monday with trainers.
items.impact: Skattebo injured his hamstring on a long run against the Texans before the Giants bye week. He will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.
items.title: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) practices on side field Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Lions center Cade Mays suffered a low ankle sprain in Sunday's game against the Vikings.
items.impact: It is unclear how long Mays will be sidelined for. He will likely miss some time.
items.title: Cade Mays suffers low ankle sprain

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Lions coach Dan Campbell said rookie LB Jimmy Rolder will be out the rest of the season.
items.impact: Rolder totaled one sack and 11 total tackles over five games as a rookie.
items.title: Jimmy Rolder (hamstring) out for season

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants signed RB Eric Gray to their practice squad.
items.impact: Gray will add depth in the backfield for New York.
items.title: Eric Gray signs with Giants practice squad

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Packers coach Matt LaFleur confirmed that Micah Parsons is expected to practice later this week.
items.impact: Parsons did not participate in Monday's walkthrough. He is expected to have his practice window opened later in the week.
items.title: Micah Parsons (knee) expected to practice later this week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Lions say LB Jack Campbell continues to rest and recover at a local hospital.
items.impact: The Lions added that preliminary indications are positive for Campbell, a positive sign for the Lions linebacker.
items.title: Jack Campbell (neck) remains in hospital Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said Kadyn Proctor is still in concussion protocol and progressing.
items.impact: Proctor's status heading into Week 9 remains up in the air.
items.title: Kadyn Proctor still in concussion protocol

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Vikings S Theo Jackson has a quad injury.
items.impact: It is unclear how serious the injury is. Jackson is day-to-day for now.
items.title: Theo Jackson has quad injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell said LT Christian Darrisaw is dealing with shoulder soreness.
items.impact: Darrisaw will continue to be further evaluated. He is day-to-day to start the week.
items.title: Christian Darrisaw dealing with shoulder injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Vikings QB Kyler Murray is being evaluated for a sore hamstring.
items.impact: Murray is being fully evaluated to start the week. He is day-to-day for now.
items.title: Kyler Murray dealing with sore hamstring

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Panthers coach Dave Canales said Brady Christensen will have his 21-day window opened this week.
items.impact: Christensen will have the next few weeks to officially be activated.
items.title: Brady Christensen to have practice window opened this week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Panthers coach Dave Canales said WR Xavier Legette could have his practice window opened this week.
items.impact: Canales added that Legette still has some things he needs to clear recovery-wise. His status will need to be monitored the rest of the week.
items.title: Xavier Legette (knee) could have practice window opened this week

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.desc: The Chiefs' defense allowed 28 points and 294 total yards. while recording one sack in Kansas City's Week 8 loss to the Broncos.
items.impact: Kansas City held Denver to 294 yards, but the defense failed to force a turnover and allowed 15 points in the fourth quarter. Jonah Coleman scored the game-winning touchdown with two minutes remaining. One sack and zero takeaways resulted in a poor fantasy day for the Chiefs D/ST.
items.title: Chiefs D/ST fails to force turnover in Week 8

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.desc: Harrison Butker made one of his two field-goal attempts and all three extra-point attempts in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8 as well.
items.impact: Butker connected from 45 yards before halftime before missing from 54 yards in the fourth quarter. The miss proved costly in a four-point loss. Still, Kansas City's offense continues to provide Butker with enough scoring opportunities to keep him in fantasy lineups.
items.title: Harrison Butker makes one field goal in Week 8

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Panthers coach Dave Canales said RB Jonathon Brooks could have his practice window opened this week.
items.impact: Canales added that Brooks still has some things he needs to clear recovery-wise. His status will need to be monitored the rest of the week.
items.title: Jonathon Brooks (core) could have practice window opened this week

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.desc: Noah Gray caught both of his targets for 15 yards and one touchdown in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
items.impact: Gray caught a four-yard touchdown for Kansas City's final score of the game. That said, he had two targets compared to seven for Travis Kelce. Gray needs touchdowns to provide fantasy value as long as Kelce is healthy.
items.title: Noah Gray scores touchdown in Week 8

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.desc: Travis Kelce caught five of seven targets for 67 yards in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
items.impact: Kelce finished second on the Chiefs in targets and receiving yards, including a 32-yard reception. Noah Gray caught Kansas City's tight end touchdown, but Kelce had seven targets compared to two for Gray. Nothing changed here. Kelce remains a TE1.
items.title: Travis Kelce records 67 receiving yards in Week 8

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Panthers head coach Dave Canales said OLB Jaelan Phillips is trending in the right direction.
items.impact: Phillips did not play in last Thursday's loss against the Packers. He is considered day-to-day.
items.title: Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) trending in the right direction

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.desc: Xavier Worthy caught three of six targets for 13 yards in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
items.impact: Worthy had six targets but averaged 4.3 yards per reception. He has 13 targets over his last two games, so opportunities aren't necessarily the problem. The production is. Worthy has 86 receiving yards over that stretch and remains a volatile fantasy option.
items.title: Xavier Worthy held to 13 yards in Week 8

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.desc: Rashee Rice caught seven of eight targets for 53 yards and one touchdown in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
items.impact: Rice led Kansas City with eight targets and seven receptions. He also caught an 11-yard touchdown in the first quarter. Rice averaged just 7.6 yards per reception, but that's secondary to the usage. He remains one of Patrick Mahomes' top options.
items.title: Rashee Rice scores touchdown in Week 8
